title: Raspberry Shake rsudp alarm
description: A Raspberry Shake running rsudp, posting its STA/LTA ALARM (and, from a wrapper, RESET) events from the custom module with contrib/rsudp/foresignal_alarm.py: JSON {"event", "time", "station", "channel"} to the generic mapping format. The record is drawn at the station point given as lon/lat. Unverified (2026-10): written from rsudp's documentation; capture a request with captureSamples before relying on it.

event.label: Event
event.description: ALARM when the STA/LTA ratio exceeded the threshold, RESET when it fell back

params.name: lon
params.description: Station longitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

params.name: lat
params.description: Station latitude (WGS84); rounded to 0.01° unless exactLocation

setup.instructions: On the Shake: copy `contrib/rsudp/foresignal_alarm.py` from the Foresignal repository, set `FORESIGNAL_URL` in it to `{url}`, and in rsudp's settings set `"custom": {"enabled": true, "codefile": "/path/to/foresignal_alarm.py", "win_override": false}` with the `alert` module enabled. rsudp runs the code file on every ALARM; the script posts `{"event": "ALARM", "time", "station", "channel"}` in under a second. rsudp's custom module does not run on RESET; run the script with the argument `RESET` from your own wrapper to post one. **Unverified (2026-10):** turn on `captureSamples` and check `GET /v1/custom-sources/{sourceId}/samples` after the first alarm.
